homepage.title: About Our Club
homepage.subtitle: Gathering Gensokyo inhabitants across generations along the ginkgo shores of Qingshuihe
homepage.intro_p1: UESTC Gensokyo (Touhou Project Fan Club at UESTC, open-source org UESTC-TOUHOU) is an enthusiastic community founded spontaneously by students and alumni of the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China. Started as informal meetups by the Qingshuihe riverside, it has grown into one of the most vibrant ACG communities on campus.
homepage.intro_p2: We embrace complete inclusivity: whether you are a Lunatic 1CC STG dodger, an avid canon setting lore researcher, a doujin music arranger, a fan artist, or simply drawn to the charming character designs, there is always a cozy place for you here at UESTC.
homepage.intro_feature1_desc: STG, fighting games, doujin music, illustration, book collecting or casual daily chats — no barrier to entry.
homepage.intro_feature2_desc: Unique UESTC engineering spirit: open-source Touhou-themed proxy clients, subtitle converters, and indie fan games.
homepage.intro_feature3_desc: Annual autumn club fairs, on-campus doujin conventions, course advice, and offline meetups creating a warm campus home.

activities_data.seed_activity_welcome_summary: Annual joint club fair booth at UESTC Qingshuihe campus with doujin game trials, fan art displays, and freshman welcome.
activities_data.act_hyxk_2023_summary: Successfully hosted at the Jiuzhou Hall in UESTC Student Activity Center, featuring fan work exhibits and open game trials.

members_data.seed_member_core_summary: Responsible for overall club operations, campus event planning, and open-source tech ecosystem maintenance.
members_data.desc_president: Oversees daily club activities, campus coordination, and public communication.
members_data.desc_tech_lead: Directs UESTC-TOUHOU GitHub organization, website infrastructure, and doujin tech projects.
members_data.desc_art_lead: Designs event posters, illustration PVs, merchandise, and visual identity.
members_data.desc_stg_lead: Coordinates official and fangame discussions, score attacks, and booth trial stations.
